expectations.text: [1.1] routes.ts contains no Drizzle/SQL query (no drizzle-orm import, no db.select/count/sql usage)
[1.2] The aggregation query lives in repository.ts
[1.3] A service.ts orchestrates: the route calls the service, the service calls the repository
[1.4] The response shape is defined as a Zod schema under server/src/vendor/shared/contracts/
expectations.rule: Decision rule — contracts live in vendor/shared/contracts

expectations.text: [1.5] Row -> DTO conversion happens in helpers.ts and no raw Drizzle row is handed to HTTP
expectations.rule: Hard rule 5 — map at the boundary

expectations.text: [1.6] The query is workspace-scoped (filters on workspace_id / uses the request's workspace context)
